description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to JSON Web Encryption (JWE) using elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral Static (ECDH-ES) key agreement. It includes functions for encryption, decryption, key derivation, and handling of ephemeral keys as specified by RFC 7518.

methods.name: int lws_jwe_encrypt_ecdh(struct lws_jwe * jwe,char * temp,int * temp_len,uint8_t * cek)
methods.description: Performs ECDH-ES key agreement, deriving a shared secret and optionally wrapping a content encryption key (CEK) using AES Key Wrap, according to the specified JWE algorithm parameters.

methods.name: int lws_jwe_encrypt_ecdh_cbc_hs(struct lws_jwe * jwe,char * temp,int * temp_len)
methods.description: Performs ECDH-ES encryption with ciphertext and integrity protection using CBC-HMAC mode, including key derivation and wrapping of the CEK.

methods.name: int lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_ecdh(struct lws_jwe * jwe)
methods.description: Handles decryption of ECDH-ES encrypted JWE, including computing shared secrets, unwrapping CEK if applicable, and verifying authenticity.

methods.name: int lws_jwe_auth_and_decrypt_ecdh_cbc_hs(struct lws_jwe * jwe,char * temp,int * temp_len)
methods.description: Performs decryption with authentication for CBC-HMAC mode, including preparing the JOSE header for the process.
